- The "stem" represents the tens digit of the number of birds in each flock.
- The "leaf" represents the ones digit.

To count flocks with at least 10 birds but fewer than 30 birds, you should interpret the data as follows:

- For stem "1", the leaves "0, 1, 5" represent 10, 11, and 15 birds.
- For stem "2", the leaves "1, 5, 9" represent 21, 25, and 29 birds.

Count all entries that fall within the range of 10 to 29 birds. In this case, there are 6 such flocks (10, 11, 15, 21, 25, 29).
